title: Construct fast dense execution of the original paired collector
body:
I supply a conditional fast execution of the original paired P104 collector, including its dense Gaussian monomial wrappers. For `n=9lambda`, `N=2^n` and linear working precision, I derive time `O(N lambda^(2-8003/6000000))` and additional clean space `O(N lambda^(5991997/3000000))+F`. I charge both calls, four wrappers, grid handling, source/query access and cleanup.

I use the credited scalar-period identity to turn PR3109's changed-order lift into an exact dense scaled-linear backend. On a sufficient power-of-two input scale, standard character conjugation then supplies whole-field CNOTs and toggles with exact shifts and literal inverse cleanup. A second residue partition preserves the original consecutive nonlinear word. I bind the construction to PR2586 events 2025–2039 through Tekalign's PR3025/3033 paired interface.

I passed eight registered cold commands on Python 3.12.13/macOS arm64. Checks include 512 ideal native columns, 2,048 affine address cases, 2,610 interval plans, original-word payloads through 257 bits, and four complete N=512 collectors matching the predecessor's query, grid and private return. I included large dirty-source cancellation, a zero sum, synthetic tensor wrappers and guard/phase controls; algebra and consumer checks also pass under `-O`.

The finite executable uses direct semantic backends. It does not benchmark or emit the fast physical C trace; the time/space result is a written construction under the retained C-layer/compiler premises. The input contract uses explicit field-major serialization and charged clean history. I claim no linear-space host, width-one Boolean speedup, new multiplication exponent or full P104 supplier. The frozen five-forward/four-dual profile still has zero-saving bill at least599/584.

Reproduce: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/dense-paired-collector`.

I credit Tekalign's PR3025/3033, Ross Richardson's PR3072, Douglas Colkitt's Fourier-conjugation analysis, ywz65's physical dual, the PR2250/2287/2899/3109 framework and Vasek/flyingviper's frozen-consumer audit. Tekalign's concurrent PR3122 reduces core history and explicitly leaves the wrapper/collector scope open; I retain a conservative collector-space bound and import none of that new code. SOURCES.json retains exact pins and source notices. Canonical coordination: [2750#18986640](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18986640).

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including analysis subagents. I claim no hosted CI, independent human or proof-assistant verification. Apache-2.0. I leave the selected frontier unchanged.
